records.notes: Produced by Milos Popovic; pinned by sha256 in forge3d.datasets registry and distributed via Git LFS media. examples/swiss_terrain_landcover_viewer.py consumes the finished asset and holds no fetch URLs; the Terrarium endpoint above is the constant used by the sibling pipeline that builds these rasters (examples/bosnia_terrain_landcover_viewer.py TERRARIUM). {z}/{x}/{y} is the XYZ tile template; the zoom and tile range used for Switzerland were not recorded.

records.notes: Credit line matches examples/swiss_terrain_landcover_viewer.py:22 verbatim. {tile} is the MGRS grid-zone id, matching the LANDCOVER_BASE_URL constant in examples/germany_terrain_landcover_viewer.py and the concrete per-tile URLs in examples/bosnia_terrain_landcover_viewer.py; the specific tile ids downloaded for the Swiss extent were not recorded in the repo. Distributed as an RGB raster whose colours are the Esri class palette, which examples/swiss_terrain_landcover_viewer.py maps back to classes.
